text: You must know each other, Kate, but you haven't worked together.
zh: 凯特，你们一定认识彼此，但你们没一起工作过。
zh_hant: 凱特，你們一定認識彼此，但你們沒一起工作過。

text: Well, yes.
So we haven't worked together, but we do know each other.
zh: 所以我们没一起工作过，但我们确实认识。
zh_hant: 所以我們沒一起工作過，但我們確實認識。

text: Know each other, yeah.
OK.
Just sort of bump into each other at things and...
zh: 就是在各种场合碰巧遇见……
zh_hant: 就是在各種場合碰巧遇見……

text: Or get mistaken for one another.
Well, I do for you.
I just take credit for everything you've done.
zh: 我就把你做的一切都揽到自己头上。
zh_hant: 我就把你做的一切都攬到自己頭上。

text: Every single thing.
I'm like, thank you, yes, thank you.
Is that because you don't look alike?
zh: 那是因为你们长得不像吗？
zh_hant: 那是因為你們長得不像嗎？

text: Is it just the name, Kate?
No, it's...
I don't know.
It wouldn't happen to you, but I get the, are you?
zh: 这种事不会发生在你身上，但我总被人问，是你吗？
zh_hant: 這種事不會發生在你身上，但我總被人問，是你嗎？

text: Are you?
I go, yes, I think so.
And then they say, I loved you in Titanic.
zh: 然后他们说，我喜欢你在《泰坦尼克号》里的表演。
zh_hant: 然後他們說，我喜歡你在《泰坦尼克號》裡的表演。

text: I get it every time.
Thank you very much.
It's been...
